product: GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 day 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07
citation: Huffman, G.J., E.F. Stocker, D.T. Bolvin, E.J. Nelkin, Jackson Tan (2019). GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 day 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07. Edited by Andrey Savtchenko. Greenbelt, MD: Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC). DOI: 10.5067/GPM/IMERGDF/DAY/07
physical_meaning: Daily mean precipitation rate in mm/day. Summing over 61 April-May days gives total seasonal accumulation in mm.

spatial_subset.method: GES DISC OPeNDAP constraint expression (server-side subsetting)

retrieval_method: GES DISC OPeNDAP server-side constraint slicing (precipitation[0:0][2700:2735][1140:1160],lat,lon)
staging_verification: Each of the 25 annual NetCDF files is cryptographically verified against its corresponding SHA-256 sidecar file in data/trends/staging/
credentials: NOT_STORED — credentials must remain in .env or ~/.netrc only
